description: Statistical Characterization of LEO E2E Latency Dataset is provided by Resource project or depositing research team (see source). The versioned Mendeley dataset contains per-packet timestamps, uplink and downlink latency and round-trip measurements from an IRTT Starlink testbed. Geographic context: unknown; not established by landing-page metadata. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: ZIP. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. It is one experimental testbed dataset; model transfer requires comparable terminals and measurement conditions. Potential simulation use: Calibrate end-to-end satellite-delay distributions. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnss-sdr offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
